inspiration: Dropped items as a small pile (builtin/game/item_entity.lua): a dropped stack is a wield-item entity that spins slowly, scaled by its size (line 67), merges with an identical stack nearby (try_merge_with, line 104 self-check), and expires after a time to live based on age (on_step, line 161). Relevant to the loot drop ceremony: the spin, the merge and the expiry are the whole pile.

Death as one calm card (builtin/game/death_screen.lua, 54 lines): an overlay with a short 'You died' title and a single respawn button (btn_respawn, line 26), with a fallback text style for clients that lack centred labels. A loss made bearable by one clear action.

Three-state touch stick art (textures/base/pack/joystick_bg.png, joystick_center.png, joystick_off.png): a ring base, a centre knob and an off state. With a chat and minimap toggle pair (chat_show_btn.png, minimap_btn.png), a readable touch vocabulary. Relevant to the touch UX fold-in.

Minimap as a HUD element with a mask (builtin/game/hud.lua line 248 registers a 'minimap' element; textures/base/pack/minimap_mask_round.png is a round mask, 512 by 512 from the PNG header). A minimap is a HUD element with a mask texture, not a separate screen.

Animated eight-legged burrower rig (games/devtest/mods/gltf/models/gltf_spider_animated.gltf): 48 unique leg bone names (four legs per side, each with base, upper, mid, fore and lower bones plus an IK target), two pincer chains with jaw bases, a head, a neck and body segments. Category idea: a wide, low, segmented creature with pincers and IK feet. Keep at category level (licence unclear).
A 16 px soft puff sprite (textures/base/pack/smoke_puff.png, 16 by 16 from the PNG header) for dust and hit smoke. A tiny soft sprite reads at small size and costs almost nothing.
Sound test tones (games/devtest/mods/soundstuff/sounds/soundstuff_sinus.ogg and soundstuff_mono.ogg): a clean sine and a mono tone set for calibrating cue loudness. Audio not played; idea only.

briefs.label: Eight-legged burrower with IK feet (category level)
briefs.why: A wide, low, segmented silhouette reads at 375 px, and IK-planted legs make the threat readable from its walk.
briefs.keep: segmented body; many legs with IK targets so the feet plant; a pincer pair at the head
briefs.change: six legs, not eight; a shell hump instead of visible segments; mandibles with their own hinge and a glowing seam
briefs.ref: games/devtest/mods/gltf/models/gltf_spider_animated.gltf (rig names, line 1; licence unclear, so category level only)

briefs.label: Loot pile spin and merge
briefs.why: Identical drops merge and spin slowly, which keeps the screen clean at a loot pile.
briefs.keep: slow spin scaled by item size; merge with an identical stack on overlap; age-based expiry
briefs.change: a rarity halo in our rarity colours; a different spin rate; a short pickup flash instead of a bare pop

briefs.label: One-button death card
briefs.why: A single respawn action on a plain overlay keeps a loss from becoming a menu.
briefs.keep: one respawn action; a plain overlay; a fallback text style
briefs.change: show the loss summary (what dropped, time to respawn) above the button; a timer instead of a bare button

briefs.label: Three-state touch stick
briefs.why: A ring, a knob and an off state make a touch stick readable without labels.
briefs.keep: ring base; centre knob; an off state when released
briefs.change: our thumb-reach placement; a lock-on forgiveness ring around the knob; our own art, not the Luanti icons
briefs.ref: textures/base/pack/joystick_bg.png, joystick_center.png, joystick_off.png (art, CC BY-SA default: keep only as a reference, redraw)

briefs.label: Soft 16 px dust puff
briefs.why: A small soft sprite gives dust and hit smoke at a glance on a phone.
briefs.keep: small soft sprite; low opacity; short life
briefs.change: our palette, a stretched sprite for dust, a directional drift
